derived: Derived from the committed vehicle data. Adds fields beside the banked matrix and changes none of it; no row is removed.
reading: No gate. The counts and rates are the evidence; each vehicle's interpretation is written prose, reviewed against the counts it quotes.

exploratory.note: Exploratory only: a one-sided Fisher exact test of deployment error against held-out home error, chosen after the counts were seen. It decides nothing.

cells.interpretation: Held out, the surrogate is wrong on 6 of 159 home rows (4%); deployed on the quiet tunnel, on 8 of 8 (100%). The failure appears on deployment, and its cause, freestream noise, is not a surrogate input.
